description: A test module utilizing pytest to assess the functionality of the RemotionTemplate class and project initialization procedures within the universalinit package. It includes fixture setups, mock template creation, and various tests for project configuration, template rendering, and script execution.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration object for a project containing name, version, description, author, type, output path, and parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration for different project types, e.g., REMOTION.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Data structure holding initialization commands and scripts for templates.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for project setup, including loading configs, template creation, and execution of post-processing scripts.

classes.name: TemplateProvider
classes.description: Provides templates given a directory, used by the factory to instantiate templates.

classes.name: RemotionTemplate
classes.description: Template class specific to Remotion projects, providing initialization info and rendering methods.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Fixture that creates and cleans up a temporary directory for tests.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Fixture that sets up a mock template directory with config and source files for testing.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Fixture that creates a mock project configuration object.

methods.name: test_remotion_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test that verifies the retrieval of initial template information includes correct commands.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Test that the project initialization creates the expected directory structure and content.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Test that post-processing scripts are executed during project setup.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Test that configuration can be loaded successfully from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verify that template placeholders in files are correctly replaced with project configuration values.
